card: Schedules deprecation for the legacy mixed-case confTarget parameter in wallet fee-bump RPCs in favor of snake_case conf_target. The wallet has documented and accepted conf_target since 2020, and this starts the removal cycle to standardize naming across RPC endpoints. RPC clients still relying on camelCase confTarget will need to enable deprecated RPCs or switch to conf_target.
evidence: Commit 91f6d2bc8ff4d4cd1b86daa370ec9d2d9662394d added documentation and support for snake_case `conf_target` in 2020 (description)
problem: Wallet fee-bumping RPC commands still accept the legacy mixed-case parameter `confTarget` alongside snake_case `conf_target`, causing naming inconsistencies across RPC parameter interfaces.

risk.why: Deprecating an RPC parameter can break external integrations and client scripts that still use camelCase confTarget without the deprecation fallback flag.

scope_notes: Small mechanical RPC deprecation across four files without the patch diff provided.
summary: Deprecates the legacy mixed-case `confTarget` argument in wallet fee-bumping RPCs in favor of `conf_target`. The change introduces standard deprecation warnings or gating under `-deprecatedrpc` ahead of removal in a future release.
uncertainties: Diff is not available; exact list of affected RPC methods and whether a deprecation flag was added cannot be directly verified.
